1. (Currently amended) A system for identifying malicious threats on a network comprising: a computing device including a processor coupled to a system memory, the system memory storing instructions for execution on the processor, the instructions configured to cause the processor to: retrieve a network data associated with at least one of an IP address or a domain __from a plurality of distinct data sources including at least one of an edge router, a border gateway protocol table, or a network flow collector__; analyze the network data __using a multi-factor risk assessment that includes comparing new activity to historical activity patterns and determining whether the new activity fits a profile for a malicious IP address or domain__ and identify a malicious network threat; and perform a mitigating action to neutralize the malicious network threat __by implementing at least one of null routing, access control list modification, bad actor publication, or network isolation__.

5. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the instructions are further configured to cause the processor to push a notification including the mitigating action for the malicious network threat to a third party device __only after the risk score exceeds a predetermined threshold and the malicious threat has been confirmed through the multi-factor risk assessment__.

10. (Currently amended) A method for identifying malicious threats on a network comprising: retrieving a network data associated with at least one of an IP address or a domain __from a plurality of distinct data sources including at least one of an edge router, a border gateway protocol table, or a network flow collector__; analyzing the network data __using a multi-factor risk assessment that includes comparing new activity to historical activity patterns and determining whether the new activity fits a profile for a malicious IP address or domain__ and identify a malicious network threat; and performing a mitigating action to neutralize the malicious network threat __by implementing at least one of null routing, access control list modification, bad actor publication, or network isolation__.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 10, further comprising pushing a notification including the mitigating action for the malicious network threat to a third party device __only after the risk score exceeds a predetermined threshold and the malicious threat has been confirmed through the multi-factor risk assessment__.
